title: root_dio_signature.py: from_cbor lacks type validation for decoded values
description:
In RootDioSignaturePayload.from_cbor() lines 151-159, decoded CBOR values are passed directly to the constructor without type validation. If a malformed payload has wrong types (e.g., dodag_id as an integer instead of bytes), __post_init__ will raise TypeError on len(self.dodag_id) rather than a clear ValueError.

File: python/src/lichen/crypto/root_dio_signature.py
Lines: 151-159

Failure scenario: Attacker sends CBOR payload with dodag_id as integer (e.g., 42) instead of bytes. Validator sees 'TypeError: object of type int has no len()' instead of 'ValueError: dodag_id must be bytes'. Error reveals implementation details and may confuse error handling logic.

Fix: Add type assertions before passing to constructor, e.g.:
if not isinstance(payload_map.get(_PAYLOAD_DODAG_ID), bytes):
    raise ValueError('dodag_id must be bytes')
